conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I applied for a business loan, and it’s taking forever! When will I get an update?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I apologize for the delay Sir. Can you provide your application ID to check the status?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s BL seven eight, nine four, five six. I need this loan ASAP!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ve checked, and your application is in the final review. It should be approved within 48 hours.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: 48 hours? Can’t you speed it up? I’m losing business here!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand the urgency. I’ll escalate it to our loan team for priority processing.
